title: Pressure, What Pressure? Sycophancy Disentanglement in Language Models via Reward Decomposition
reasoning: The paper investigates sycophancy (the tendency of models to agree with users regardless of truth) and proposes a reward decomposition method. While it discusses 'honesty' and mentions 'moral sycophancy' as a limitation in its conclusion, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, specific moral frameworks, or ethical systems.
